title: Expose new tutorials as primary tutorials, remove old copies
body:
* List the new tutorials as "the" tutorials.
 * Remove copies of many old tutorials if they were already ported to sphinx-gallery.

# Checklist: `x` (done) or `~` (irrelevant)

- [ ] [I am familiar with **ASE's contribution guidelines.**](https://ase-lib.org/development/contribute.html)
- [ ] [**Doc strings** in code changed in this MR are up to date.](https://ase-lib.org/development/python_codingstandard.html#writing-documentation-in-the-code)
- [ ] [**Unit tests** have been added for new or changed code.](https://ase-lib.org/development/tests.html)
- [ ] [**Changes** have been added in `changelog.d` using `scriv`.](https://ase-lib.org/development/writing_changelog.html)
- [ ] [**Issue is resolved** via "closes #XXXX" if applicable.](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/project/issues/managing_issues.html#closing-issues-automatically)
author: askhl

comments.author: askhl
comments.body: @HannaTuerk As of this MR, each tutorial should exist exactly once.  As you may have noticed I also went through the issues in %"Tutorials with sphinx gallery" and closed some that do not apply anymore.  Of course there's still a fair number of tutorials left to work on.

comments.author: askhl
comments.body:
Thanks a lot @HannaTuerk!

Hopefully we (almost) don't need to delete any pngs or trajs, since those were generally generated by the tutorials dynamically, already before.  But there's probably a file or two that crept in nevertheless  :sweat_smile:

comments.author: askhl
comments.body:
I suppose if it's all okay with you we don't need to wait for anything else.

Merging then.  Thanks!

comments.author: HannaTuerk
comments.body:
Hi Ask, looks amazing! 
Thank you also for deleting already a lot of the old examples, we can probably do a second run deleting all unnecessary files (.traj, .png ..) soon! I'll open an issue for this on the Wikisprint Milestone, hopefully the doc folder becomes a bit more organized this way.
Also thanks for deleting the genetic examples, I was meaning to ask if we want to keep them or not.

thread.actionability_reasoning: This is a social/acknowledgment comment with no concrete code change requested. The mention of deleting unnecessary files is deferred to a future issue, not a request for changes in this PR.

comments.author: HannaTuerk
comments.body: Hi @askhl , are we ready to merge this before the meeting tomorrow? If there is something left we should do before merging let me know, I have some time today
